last_checked.description:
The last role and authorization that was checked, if any existed. If
this is set, use it as the start_after for the next query.

reason.description: The reason for the authorization failure.

enabled.description: Whether or not the role and all its authorizations are enabled.

metadata.description:
Optional metadata for the role. This should either be a JSON object or
IPFS hash.

name.description: Name for the role (ideally unique, but not enforced).

enabled.description: Whether or not the authorization is enabled.

filter.description:
Optional `cw-jsonfilter` filter (JSON-encoded string). If no filter is
provided, no messages will be allowed, making it simply a symbolic
authorization (which may be useful for external systems).

metadata.description:
Optional metadata for the authorization. This should either be a JSON
object or IPFS hash.

name.description: Name for the authorization (ideally unique, but not enforced).
